1.text: How do you keep up with seller follow-ups and still find time to film?

2.text: I set up the routine ones once, in Repeat.

3.text: Each seller status gets its own template, so a new prospect and a seller who's already listed get different messages.

4.text: Status follow-ups send each one when that seller is due.

5.text: And they stop as soon as a seller replies, so the conversation stays with me.

6.text: So the follow-ups keep going while I'm filming?

7.text: Yes, within the sending hours and daily limit you set.

8.text: Repeat AI. Set up your follow-ups once.
